title: Pre-Analysis — Auxiliary Power Unit Firewall Panel and Drain Mast Rework
abstract: Re-analysis of the auxiliary power unit firewall panel rework, opened for a spares and effectivity extension, covering the drain flow acceptance, the parts figure and the crew-facing description of the compartment.

sections.objective: The rework was released in 2018 and cut into production, but a group of operators outside the original effectivity asked for it after two of them reported the same corrosion pattern. The round was opened to establish whether the effectivity could be extended without redesign, and what published content would have to move with it.
sections.findings_summary: Four items were confirmed and the extension was recommended, but the decision on how to fund it was handed to the customer support organisation, which is why the outcome is recorded as delegated. The retrofit bulletin is the only place the drain flow acceptance time is stated, and that time is the acceptance test for the whole installation; extending the effectivity means the bulletin becomes the governing document for aircraft it was not written for. The parts figure carries the original and the reworked panel as alternates and its effectivity note has to be restated. The installation task holds the sealant cure period that must elapse before the unit can be started, which is the real driver of the ground time quoted. The fourth finding is the crew-facing description of the compartment, which mentions the fire protection arrangement in language that shares nothing with the engineering text and would nevertheless have to change.
sections.next_steps: Extend the effectivity to the requesting operators and restate the parts figure effectivity note. Hand the funding position to customer support with the corrosion finding rate attached. Issue the crew entry change with the maintenance content rather than after it.

similarity_seeds: standing fluid on a firewall panel lower edge producing repeated corrosion
compartment drain path that does not clear under all ground attitudes

tasks.title: Establish what the bulletin governs once the effectivity is extended
Map the parts and maintenance content that must move
Screen the crew-facing description of the compartment

expected_findings.rationale: The bulletin is the only place the drain flow acceptance time is stated, and that time is the acceptance test for the whole installation. Extending the effectivity makes it the governing document for aircraft it was not written for.
expected_findings.resolution: Revise the bulletin effectivity and restate the acceptance time for the added population.

expected_findings.rationale: The figure carries the original and the reworked panel as alternates and its effectivity note no longer matches the population once the bulletin is extended.
The installation task holds the sealant cure period that must elapse before the unit can be started, which is the real driver of the quoted ground time.
expected_findings.resolution: Quote the ground time from the task rather than from the bulletin.

evidence.similarity_note: The crew entry talks about what the unit supplies and how to manage it on a hot ramp; the modification talks about a firewall panel edge and a drain mast. No identifier and almost no vocabulary is shared, yet the compartment description the crew reads changes.

expected_findings.rationale: The crew-facing description of the compartment mentions the fire protection arrangement in language that shares nothing with the engineering text, and it has to change with the panel standard.
expected_findings.resolution: Issue the crew entry change together with the maintenance content.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares the aft fuselage access and reads as a corrosion inspection in almost the same words, but it inspects the rear pressure bulkhead and has no interface with the auxiliary power unit compartment or its drain path.

type_data.conclusion: Closed with a recommendation to extend and a funding question handed to customer support. The engineering position is that no redesign is needed.
